target_customer: Software developers and remote engineering teams who pair program
problem: Remote pairing needed screen sharing plus separate chat; Duckly combined video chat with shared IDE, terminal and browser.
business_model: Freemium SaaS with paid team plans
product_category: Developer collaboration and pair programming tool

founders.name: Dragos Fotescu
founders.background_notes: Only founder listed on the YC page; no education or employers listed.

competitors.name: Visual Studio Live Share
competitors.what: Microsoft real-time collaborative editing and debugging in Visual Studio and VS Code
competitors.traction_then: Public preview for about a year, then generally available in April 2019

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time sync of IDE, terminal and browser plus low-latency video across many IDE plugins is demanding for a team of five.

defensibility.rationale: Free Microsoft Live Share covered much of the pairing use case and no lock-in was described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Microsoft shipped Live Share free and bundled; JetBrains Code With Me followed per later listings (undated).

market_need_then: Remote work in 2020 raised demand for pair programming tools; no hard spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Used gitduck.com, which now redirects (301) to duckly.com.

identity.logo: Duck themed; the company blog describes designing its logo with a rubber duck methodology

rebrands.why: Blog post says the new name welcomes different ways of working; the date is inferred from image paths so approximate

brand_strength.rationale: Playful duck theme but little press found; rename away from Git suggests the first name was limiting.

outcome_analysis: GitDuck, renamed Duckly, joined YC in Summer 2020 and reported a small seed. The YC directory lists it inactive, yet duckly.com still showed login, pricing and a changelog when fetched, so the status conflict is unresolved. No shutdown, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors are empty.
notes: Seed rests on aggregators only (CB Insights says 130K over 2 rounds dated 2020-08-25; Employbl and Dealroom about 125K); it may be the standard YC deal. CB Insights also lists stage acquired with no buyer, unverified. Founder name Fotescu appears on YC page; other co-founders not found. Tuple was suggested as a rival by search results but no dated source was found, so it is not listed. Live Share source is dated April 2019, before the batch.
